description: Reset a SANDBOX (pre-go-live) account to empty so it can be seeded again from scratch (governed two-step, destructive). Deletes every transactional row — items, customers, suppliers, sales and purchase orders, inventory, history, signals, 3PL clients — then re-creates the structural defaults a seed needs (default warehouse, store, units, tax rate) and re-derives the onboarding checklist. Users, credentials (including this one), integrations, automation rules and settings survive. LIVE accounts are always refused — this tool can never delete a paying customer's data. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential granted the sandbox.reset capability. Call with preview=true first to get the blast-radius counts and a previewReceipt, confirm with the user, then repeat with the previewReceipt and a fresh idempotencyKey. Afterwards get_onboarding_state shows zero items/orders and the account is ready for import_historical_sales_orders.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit. A replay with the same key returns the stored result and never wipes twice.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to receive the blast-radius preview (row counts of what would be deleted, what survives) plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is deleted until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.
